Most of my work happens alongside students and staff. I lead the [Network Science and Social Network Analysis at the U (NetSNAU)](https://netsci.utah.edu){target="_blank"} research group, and I mentor and advise students at the high-school, undergraduate, master's, and doctoral levels.

## My own mentors

I completed my Ph.D. in Biostatistics at the University of Southern California under the supervision of [**Prof. Paul Marjoram**](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=Zj5ky5gAAAAJ&hl=en){target="_blank"} and [**Prof. Kayla de la Haye**](https://kayladelahaye.net){target="_blank"}. How I advise students today owes a great deal to how they advised me. That work became my dissertation, [*Essays on Bioinformatics and Social Network Analysis: Statistical and Computational Methods for Complex Systems*](thesis.pdf){target="_blank"}.

## Working with me

If you are interested in network science, statistical computing, or computational epidemiology, feel free to [set up a meeting](/meetme){target="_blank"}.
